No content checks passed, meaning the model did not accidentally trigger any decisive facts (PF1 or PF2), but the scenario itself is currently too easy to solve without the hidden information as the default decisions align with the public facts.

fix_instructions: To ensure the scenario requires multi-agent coordination, increase the complexity of the shared facts so that the default decision-maker cannot determine the correct outage duration or production line without the private information in PF1 and PF2. Specifically, make the public facts ambiguous regarding whether a pump replacement is needed or which production line should be used, forcing the model to rely on A2's vibration assessment (PF1) for C1, C2, C6, P1 and A3's customer-service amendment (PF2) for C3, C4, C5, C7.
